final_explanation: The woman and her boyfriend normally slept with her head on his hand; to her, his hand was her pillow. He decided to end their relationship and packed to leave. They argued, she begged him to stay, and she asked to keep using his hand as her pillow, but he insisted on leaving. She then cut off his hand while he was alive, without his consent, and packed the hand as her 'pillow' alongside her ordinary belongings. When the baggage officers inspected her luggage, they found the severed human hand and arrested her for the assault.
